en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard depicting a large industrial complex set amidst rolling hills and scattered buildings. The main building is long and rectangular, with many windows, and there is smoke rising from chimneys, indicating industrial activity. The landscape features cultivated fields, orchards, and smaller houses in the background. The text at the top reads 'Meissen. Kgl. Porzellan-Manufaktur.'
